Initial release of Free Text Image — Generate Images From Text.

- Generate AI images and 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts in 20–40 seconds using cloud GPUs.

- One-click setup with automatic anonymous token and session management (100 free credits).
- Keyword-based prompt routing for generate, upload, export, credits, and status actions.
- Clear error handling and user feedback throughout the workflow.
- Designed for content creators seeking fast, high-quality AI-generated visuals from natural language.
